procedure: Bind each control to risk IDs and assertions, owner, frequency, input population and expected evidence. Separate design adequacy from actual operating effectiveness.

Retain test selection rationale, coverage, exclusions and executed evidence. Test failure paths when applicable. Report observed exceptions with numerator and denominator; samples alone do not establish population error or a probability guarantee.

Compare actual evidence with unchanged criteria and link uncovered exposure to plan nodes. Unperformed checks remain unverified. Route remediation and fresh independent retest; a producer self-check cannot become independent assurance.

acceptance.expectation: Current inputs and actual plan task/risk bindings are recorded; stale inputs return restricted results.
Named outputs reflect performed work, uncertainty and method-specific limits; risk evidence grants no authority.

conditions: Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; affected object, missing evidence/test, owner, next action and restriction
